label.zh: 若日后攻击打捞者，打捞大师将离去
label.en: If we later attack the Salvagers, the Master Salvager leaves

bridges.evidence: on_entering_battle -> enclave.390 (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:6717-6740) requires a master_salvager leader, then enclave.8000 after 5 days

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次接触完成或“通讯已建立”后经enclave.304打开，之后每次外交联络经enclave.300（on_custom_diplomacy）打开。各项服务返回本菜单，是可重复的服务枢纽。“面纱旅人”询问会转到虚境行者城邦的窗口（enclave.7110）。
notes.en: Review note: opened through enclave.304 after first contact or 'Communications Established', and through enclave.300 (on_custom_diplomacy) on every later diplomatic contact. Services return here: a repeatable service hub. The Veilfarer question opens the Shroudwalkers' window (enclave.7110).

notes.zh: 审阅注：玩家研究战列舰、5级恒星基地、巨型工程或（非虚空居民）栖息地科技时，若尚未与打捞者接触，由其主动问候并赠送合金（00_on_actions.txt:2703 on_tech_increased）。
notes.en: Review note: when a player researches battleships, starbase tier 5, mega-engineering or (non-Void Dweller) habitats without having met the Salvagers, they greet the player and send alloys (00_on_actions.txt:2703 on_tech_increased).

notes.zh: 审阅注：“成交”后若已无可用残骸则为enclave.342；否则先显示enclave.341，60–90天后送达“委托打捞”（enclave.365）。341与365是先后关系，不互斥。
notes.en: Review note: after 'Deal', enclave.342 if no debris remains; otherwise enclave.341 now and 'Commissioned Salvage' (enclave.365) 60-90 days later. 341 and 365 are sequential, not alternatives.

scope.zh: 完整：入口、七项服务及其延迟后续、面纱旅人跨故事链接、引见事件。
scope.en: Complete: entries, seven services and delayed follow-ups, Veilfarer cross-link, introduction.
